summary: Talabat Mart Oman's fresh-vegetables category page and its parsley product page fetched cleanly and gave verbatim prices for most roots-and-stems and fruiting-crops benchmarks; Lulu Hypermarket Oman blocked all direct page fetches (403) so its cherry-tomato and strawberry prices come from search-result snippets instead, and several other Talabat product pages returned a store-availability gate with no price when fetched directly (their prices, where used, are likewise from search snippets and flagged as such). No usable, well-attributed prices were found for butterhead-style lettuce, kale, arugula, mint, or coriander, and no microgreens or edible-flower listings turned up at any of the six suggested Oman retailers within the research budget, so those benchmarks are listed as not found and the microgreens and edible-flowers categories have zero observations.
